title: Prevalence of Globo H - a novel glycotarget - and association to clinicopathological features in human breast cancer
summary: Aim of the study is to obtain prevalence data on the expression of Globo H via immunohistochemistry in human breast cancer samples.

interventions.name:
Non-interventional, retrospective biobank study
The expression of Globo H will be analysed on tissue sections by immunohistochemical stainings and then correlated to clinical parameters (staging, grading, etc.). In addition, already existing molecular data (e.g. Her2-status, Ki-67 proliferation rat

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Breast cancer (luminal B1/B2 or Her2/neu amplified)
Exclusion criteria:
none
